metadata.title: AI’s Central Bank Is in Crisis. Intel and These Stocks Are Feeling the Pain.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Intel and Marvell Stocks Are Caught in Nvidia’s Web
Intel and other stocks which Nvidia has invested in were trading lower in premarket trading Thursday. The potential ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang raises some questions over the future of the chip maker’s stakes in companies across the artificial-intelligence supply chain.
